entities.name: Ethyl ester hydrolysis
observations: The supplied structures differ by conversion of an ethyl ester, CCOC(=O), to a carboxylic acid, C(=O)O; the remainder of the scaffold is unchanged.
The decoded reactant formula is C33H41N7O4 and product formula is C31H37N7O4, consistent with loss of ethyl ester alkyl atoms during ester-to-acid conversion.
